messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: HIGH - GPU pool saturation detected in us-west1. autoscaler failed to provision new nodes (quota_error). queue length for model-serving-default has grown from 20 -> 120 in 6m. Errors: downstream 429 throttles. Paging: priya (oncall).

priya (oncall): seeing it, joining. what's impacted? any customer 5xx?

theo (sre): confirmed increased 429/504 on /v1/generate for several customers. Token backend latency also rising. autoscaler logs show: 
```
ERROR: allocation failed: quotaExceeded: GCE GPU quota insufficient for request (requested=8, available=0)
```

marta (infra): autoscaler tried to spin 4 new nodes but hit region quota. us-west1 has a pending quota increase request that's not approved yet. fallback pools in us-east1 have capacity but routing policy still prefers us-west1 until we hit risk thresholds.

priya (oncall): can we spill traffic to us-east1 manually? priority: avoid customer 5xx.

theo (sre): yes, but two things: 1) some routes are pinned (enterprise customers) — must not touch without consent, 2) routing layer has a buggy failover threshold set to 95% instead of 85% in the last deploy. might need a toggle.

marta (infra): I can flip the routing toggle to allow immediate spillover. patch: `routing.allow_spillover = true` in config-service. doing it now.

deploy-bot: rolling config change to routing-service -> canary (3/3) -> applied.

priya (oncall): monitoring? I will throttle background workloads and lower default batch_size for best-effort tenants. Theo - can you run the emergency throttle script for non-paid tenants?

theo (sre): running: `scripts/traffic-control throttle --label=best-effort --pct=70` -> done. seeing reduction in queue growth rate.

nora (cs): which customers are impacted so I can notify support? early list from traces: Playlyst (high percentile errors), AcmeCorp (increased latency), internal smoke tests failing. No SEC customers pinned to us-west1.

priya (oncall): good. Marta, confirm that us-east1 pool currently has enough GPU headroom and compatible model variants (quantized checkpoints ok).

marta (infra): us-east1 has headroom for the standard Llama-2-variant and quantized 4-bit variants. Note: east1 has different kernel builds — possible minor perf delta. I'm enabling cross-region steering for live traffic. Config snippet: 
```
PATCH /v1/configs/routing
{
  "spillover_policy": "immediate",
  "allowed_regions": ["us-east1","us-west1"]
}
```
deploy-bot: spillover_policy set -> success.

priya (oncall): starting manual reroute: set weight us-east1=0.6, us-west1=0.4 for affected routes. Doing gradual 10% steps.

theo (sre): after first step (10%) we saw 20% drop in 429s for Playlyst. latency stable for AcmeCorp so far. continuing to 60%.

marta (infra): autoscaler quota request is still pending; PM requested we avoid fake quota escalations. I'll open a ticket with cloud-provider. Ticket: https://cloud.example.com/tickets/98765 - ETA unknown.

priya (oncall): action items: 1) keep spillover enabled, 2) maintain throttles on best-effort, 3) notify CS for customers with pinned routes, 4) escalate quota with cloud contacts.

nora (cs): will message affected accounts with ETA and temporary mitigation steps. drafting message now.

theo (sre): also found a secondary issue: routing-service was honoring health checks but not excluding nodes reporting degraded KV-cache memory. That caused occasional per-token slowdowns -> some requests timed out and retried -> increased queue. I pushed a hotfix to health-check logic to remove nodes with kv_cache_pressure > 80%.

deploy-bot: hotfix deployment to routing-service -> success (rev 2026.3.0-hotfix).

priya (oncall): monitoring after hotfix and spillover: queues dropping from 120 -> 30 over 12m. 429s reduced by ~78%. Latency p95 for critical tenants now within SLO.

marta (infra): note for postmortem: autoscaler should fallback to burst-spot-mode when quota-limited and secondary-region capacity exists. currently it fails hard.

theo (sre): agreed. adding early-warning metric: regional_quota_headroom < 10% triggers preemptive spillover at 70% utilization.

priya (oncall): handing off to theo for next shift. Please include timeline and actions taken in incident doc. I'll update status page and mark customers notified.

theo (sre): taking it. timeline + RCA notes will go to /incidents/2034567890-doc.

pagerbot: incident severity lowered to SEV-2. next update in 30m or on significant change.

priya (oncall): final note: avoid mass config flips without canarying; manual spillover was the right call here. follow-up: quota request + autoscaler burst-mode design change. :white_check_mark:
